prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED WARM TAN / OCHRE flat color field — think #C18A63,
a rich confident desert-tan or dried-grass ochre, the color of a
classic board-game "plains/wastes" tile. Clearly WARM and BROWNISH,
NOT grey, NOT cream-white, NOT bone-neutral. Visibly distinct from
the cool-grey crags tile. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-
edge with this one warm-tan color corner to corner — NO drawn hex,
NO paper border, NO vignette, NO centered composition, NO visible
features. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same
tan hue. A region-fill swatch, not a tile with a shape drawn on it.
formatted_prompt: Vibrant game-map terrain tile, flat comic-book-map register, saturated warm-tan color field filling the entire 1024×1024 square edge-to-edge, corner to corner. Rich desert-tan ochre — the confident brownish warmth of #C18A63 dried-grass plains — covers every pixel with zero horizon, zero focal subject, zero vignette. The whole image is one bold warm-tan wash, clearly brownish and warm, visibly distinct from any cool or neutral tone. Only the faintest brushstroke texture variation within the same ochre hue, like a freshly inked board-game terrain region. No drawn hex outline, no border, no frame, no centered object, no shadow gradients. Pure saturated plains-wastes swatch, punchy and unambiguous.
